description: P8-95, EV-95: the coverage and gap answers of the first eShop plan try of 2026-11-02 (planner coverage.v2 and gap.v4, Haiku), unchanged. The gap answer writes 20 task cards for 29 of the 33 items of its block and none for flow:FLOW-002, FLOW-009, FLOW-010 and FLOW-012, whose work the plan card T-004 already does; it leaves no card out. Source: the public eShopModernizing (MIT licence); no employer text.
